title: Soft-Body Flamingo Puppet with Facial Mimic
description: A flamingo with soft-body jelly-like physics hovers in front of a large floating face. The user pokes and stretches the flamingo's body, and each deformation triggers the face to react with corresponding morph-target expressions — squishing the flamingo's belly makes the face puff cheeks, pulling wings makes it wince, and bouncing it makes the face laugh. Complete all 8 interaction challenges to master the puppet.
prompt: Create a single HTML file using Three.js r170 with GLTFLoader and OrbitControls from CDN. Load flamingo.glb and facecap.glb. Place the flamingo center-screen and the facecap head floating 3 units to the right, scaled 2x. Camera at (0,2,6) looking at origin. Use hemisphere light (sky 0x88ccff, ground 0x443322, intensity 1.2) plus a directional light with soft shadows. Implement a soft-body simulation on the flamingo mesh: duplicate its geometry buffer, store rest positions, and on each frame apply spring-damper forces (stiffness 0.4, damping 0.85) so vertices return to rest but wobble when disturbed. On mouse/touch raycasting against the flamingo, apply a radial push force (radius 0.6, strength 2.0) displacing vertices outward from the hit point. Track cumulative deformation magnitude per frame. Map deformation metrics to facecap morph targets: when average displacement > 0.05 drive 'mouthOpen' and 'jawOpen'; when > 0.12 drive 'mouthSmile_L' and 'mouthSmile_R'; when vertical stretch detected drive 'browInnerUp'; when compression detected drive 'cheekPuff'. Smoothly lerp morph influences toward targets (lerp factor 0.08). Implement 8 sequential interaction challenges shown in an overlay panel: (1) Poke the flamingo belly, (2) Pull left wing outward, (3) Squish from above, (4) Stretch vertically, (5) Rapid multi-poke combo, (6) Hold-and-release bounce, (7) Twist deformation via circular drag, (8) Achieve simultaneous activation of 4+ face morphs. Validate each step: measure displacement direction, magnitude thresholds, timing windows, and morph-target activation counts. Show a progress bar and step description. On completion, trigger a celebration where the flamingo wobbles autonomously and the face cycles through all expressions. Add a reset button. Use parameter validation: clamp spring stiffness 0.2-0.8, damping 0.7-0.95, push strength 0.5-4.0 with a small debug GUI (dat.gui or lil-gui).
